articles.title: Takaichi administration's move toward militarization sparks concerns
articles.titleCn: 高市政府的军事化动向引发担忧

articles.fullText:
Japanese residents have recently taken to the streets to protest what they see as the Takaichi administration's moves toward militarization, calling on the government to confront its wartime history and avoid repeating the mistakes of the past.
The concerns came amid a series of developments involving Japan's defense and security policies.
On July 31, Japan launched its National Intelligence Bureau, marking the establishment of the country's first centralized national intelligence organization since World War II.
On August 4, Japan's Defense Ministry released its annual defense white paper, "Defense of Japan 2026," stating that the country would further strengthen its "counterstrike capabilities" by developing air-launched and ship-launched variants of the Type 25 missile and advancing research into hypersonic weapons.
Kyodo News reported on Friday that Japan's Defense Ministry plans to seek a record budget of 8.9 trillion yen (nearly $56 billion) for fiscal 2027. The final budget will also reflect the results of an ongoing review of Japan's three key national security documents. A senior government official said defense spending could ultimately reach around 10 trillion yen.
Concerns over Japan's future nuclear policy have also intensified. The debate was fueled after Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called in July for Japan to discuss all nuclear-related policy options "without taboo." At a ceremony Thursday marking the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi refrained from saying whether her government would continue to uphold Japan's Three Non-Nuclear Principles.
An anti-nuclear weapons event is held in Nagasaki, Japan, August 7, 2026. 
'Tragedy never be repeated'
An anti-nuclear weapons event was held in Nagasaki on Friday ahead of the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing.
At a gathering in Osaka on Thursday night, a protester told China Media Group that the Takaichi administration's recent moves had made her fear that Japan could once again move toward militarism.
"That prompted me to revisit materials on Japan's wartime aggression and related historical issues. The more I learned, the more I felt that such a tragedy must never be repeated," she said.
Another protester expressed concerns over the newly established National Intelligence Bureau, questioning whether it could eventually resemble the Tokko (Special Higher Police), the repressive militarist secret police that crushed dissent and enforced wartime conformity.
"It makes me concerned that Japan may still be considering a path toward war," she said.
At a rally in Hiroshima on Wednesday evening, Mayuri Matsuo told Xinhua that, given the painful lessons of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Japan should continue promoting the ideals of peace. However, she said recent developments suggest that the country is "moving in the exact opposite direction."
At the site devastated by the atomic bombing, Tomoko Tamura, chairperson of the Japanese Communist Party, said any attempt to revise the Three Non-Nuclear Principles would be unacceptable.
The Mainichi Shimbun published an editorial on Friday criticizing Koizumi's nuclear-related remarks, saying they "trample" on Japan's long-standing non-nuclear principles.
"Revising the three principles would reverse Japan's path as a pacifist nation and undermine trust in the country," said the editorial, adding that "Having experienced the devastation of nuclear attacks, Japan has a responsibility to continue calling for the abolition of nuclear weapons and must not forget that responsibility."
Hundreds of paper lanterns float along the Motoyasu River during the annual lantern floating ceremony marking the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, in Hiroshima, Japan, August 6, 2026. 
A threat to regional stability
Public opinion surveys also indicate continued support for Japan's non-nuclear policy. A recent poll conducted by the Japan Association for Public Opinion Research showed that 76% of respondents support maintaining the country's Three Non-Nuclear Principles, while 77% oppose Japan pursuing nuclear sharing arrangements under which the US would station nuclear weapons in Japan.
Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said on Friday that Japan should listen to domestic calls against nuclear weapons and stop undermining the Three Non-Nuclear Principles.
Lin urged Japanese authorities to fulfill their obligations under international law, refrain from accepting, producing, possessing or proliferating nuclear weapons, and "stop playing with fire" on the nuclear issue.
In an interview with China Media Group, Zhang Yulai, a professor at Nankai University's Japan Institute, said the most likely point of change would be the third principle – "not allowing nuclear weapons to be introduced into Japan" – with the Japanese government reportedly considering revising it through a Cabinet decision.
Zhang warned that revising the third principle would effectively undermine the Three Non-Nuclear Principles as a whole. Such a move, he said, could disrupt the Asia-Pacific order, the East Asian order and the postwar international order, while fueling a regional arms race.
articles.fullTextCn:
日本居民近日走上街头，抗议他们认为的高市政府的军事化动向，呼吁政府正视其战时历史，避免重蹈覆辙。这些担忧是在日本国防和安全政策的一系列发展背景下出现的。7月31日，日本启动了国家情报局，标志着自二战以来该国首个中央集权国家情报组织的建立。8月4日，日本防卫省发布了年度国防白皮书《2026年日本防卫》，称将通过开发25型导弹的空射和舰射变体以及推进高超音速武器研究，进一步加强其“反击能力”。共同社周五报道，日本防卫省计划为2027财年申请创纪录的8.9万亿日元（近560亿美元）预算。

最终预算还将反映对日本三项关键国家安全文件正在进行的审查结果。一位高级政府官员表示，国防开支最终可能达到约10万亿日元。对日本未来核政策的担忧也在加剧。防卫大臣小泉进次郎7月呼吁日本“无禁忌地”讨论所有核相关政策选项后，这一辩论被激化。在周四纪念广岛原子弹爆炸81周年的仪式上，首相高市早苗回避了是否继续坚持日本无核三原则的问题。2026年8月7日，日本长崎举行了一场反核武器活动。

“悲剧永不再重演”

周五，在原子弹爆炸81周年纪念日前夕，长崎举行了一场反核武器活动。周四晚上在大阪的一次集会上，一位抗议者告诉中国媒体集团，高市政府的近期举动让她担心日本可能再次走向军国主义。“这促使我重新审视日本战时侵略及相关历史问题的材料。我了解得越多，就越觉得这样的悲剧绝不能重演，”她说。另一位抗议者对新成立的国家情报局表示担忧，质疑它最终是否会类似于特高警察，即镇压异议并强制战时一致的压迫性军国主义秘密警察。

“这让我担心日本可能仍在考虑走向战争的道路，”她说。周三晚上在广岛的一次集会上，松尾真由里告诉新华社，鉴于广岛和长崎的惨痛教训，日本应继续弘扬和平理念。然而，她说近期发展表明该国正“朝着完全相反的方向前进”。在原子弹爆炸破坏的遗址上，日本共产党委员长田村智子表示，任何修改无核三原则的企图都是不可接受的。《每日新闻》周五发表社论批评小泉的核相关言论，称其“践踏”了日本长期以来的无核原则。“修改这三项原则将逆转日本作为和平国家的道路，并损害对国家的信任，”社论说，并补充道，“经历过核攻击的破坏，日本有责任继续呼吁废除核武器，绝不能忘记这一责任。”2026年8月6日，在日本广岛，数百盏纸灯笼在元安川上漂浮，参加纪念原子弹爆炸81周年的年度放灯仪式。

对地区稳定的威胁

民意调查也显示对日本无核政策的持续支持。日本舆论调查协会最近进行的一项民意调查显示，76%的受访者支持维持该国的无核三原则，而77%的人反对日本追求核共享安排，即美国在日本部署核武器。中国外交部发言人林剑周五表示，日本应倾听国内反对核武器的呼声，停止破坏无核三原则。林剑敦促日本当局履行国际法义务，不接受、不生产、不拥有或扩散核武器，并在核问题上“停止玩火”。南开大学日本研究院教授张玉来在接受中国媒体集团采访时表示，最可能改变的一点是第三项原则——“不允许核武器引入日本”——据报道，日本政府正在考虑通过内阁决定来修改这一原则。

张玉来警告说，修改第三项原则将有效破坏无核三原则的整体性。他说，这样的举动可能扰乱亚太秩序、东亚秩序和战后国际秩序，同时加剧地区军备竞赛。

articles.title: Scientists reveal how aging weakens the brain's protective barrier
articles.titleCn: 科学家揭示衰老如何削弱大脑的保护屏障
articles.summary: Scientists reveal how aging weakens the brain's protective barrier
articles.summaryCn: 研究发现衰老通过TGF-β1信号增加脑内皮细胞转运，导致血脑屏障渗漏，进而影响认知功能。

paragraphs.en:
As people age, many experience memory decline and slower {{0}} processing, along with a higher risk of {{1}} disease and cognitive {{2}}. One important question in aging research is how changes in the brain's blood vessels contribute to cognitive decline. Scientists from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have identified a {{3}} by which aging weakens the blood-brain barrier, the brain's protective {{4}} with the bloodstream. The study was published in Neuron under the title "TGF-β1-induced endothelial {{5}} drives blood-brain barrier {{6}} during aging."
The study shows how aging {{7}} {{17}} in brain blood vessel cells, leading to blood-brain barrier leakage. /SIAT
The blood-brain barrier, or BBB, acts as a {{8}} security system.
paragraphs.cn: 随着年龄增长，许多人会经历记忆力下降和认知处理速度变慢，同时患脑血管疾病和认知障碍的风险也会增加。衰老研究中的一个重要问题是大脑血管的变化如何导致认知衰退。中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院（SIAT）的科学家们识别出了一种衰老削弱血脑屏障（大脑与血液之间的保护性界面）的机制。该研究发表在《神经元》杂志上，题为“TGF-β1诱导的内皮细胞转胞吞作用驱动衰老过程中的血脑屏障渗漏”。该研究展示了衰老如何扰乱脑血管细胞中的运输，导致血脑屏障渗漏。血脑屏障（BBB）作为一个选择性的安全系统。

paragraphs.en: It allows {{9}} nutrients to reach the brain while preventing potentially {{10}} substances in the blood from entering brain tissue. Damage to this barrier has been linked to cognitive aging, cerebral small vessel disease and several {{11}} disorders. Scientists have traditionally {{12}} BBB leakage mainly to damage to the tight seals between cells lining brain blood vessels. However, the new study found that another process occurs earlier during aging. By examining mice at different ages, the researchers found that BBB leakage was already {{13}} in middle-aged mice and worsened in older animals.
paragraphs.cn: 它允许必需营养物质到达大脑，同时防止血液中潜在的有害物质进入脑组织。这种屏障的损伤与认知衰老、脑小血管疾病和多种神经退行性疾病有关。科学家传统上将血脑屏障渗漏主要归因于脑内血管内皮细胞之间紧密连接的损伤。然而，新研究发现，在衰老过程中另一个过程发生得更早。通过检查不同年龄的小鼠，研究人员发现，血脑屏障渗漏在中年小鼠中已可检测到，并在老年动物中恶化。

paragraphs.en: The change appeared early in the {{14}}, a brain region important for learning and memory. At this stage, the seals between blood vessel cells remained largely {{15}}. Instead, the cells' internal transport system became {{16}} active, allowing blood-borne substances to pass through the cells and enter brain tissue. "Rather than first leaking through gaps between cells, the aging blood-brain barrier appears to lose control over transport {{18}} inside the cells," the researchers said. The team identified a protein called Mfsd2a as an important part of this protective system.
paragraphs.cn: 这种变化早期出现在海马体，这是一个对学习和记忆重要的大脑区域。在这个阶段，血管细胞之间的连接基本保持完整。相反，细胞内部的运输系统变得异常活跃，使得血液中的物质穿过细胞进入脑组织。研究人员表示：“衰老的血脑屏障似乎不是首先通过细胞间隙渗漏，而是失去了对细胞内运输途径的控制。”团队识别出一种名为Mfsd2a的蛋白质，它是这个保护系统的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Mfsd2a normally limits unnecessary transport across brain blood vessels. Its levels declined with age, while Caveolin-1, a protein involved in the formation of transport vesicles, increased. When the researchers {{19}} endothelial Mfsd2a expression or {{20}} down Caveolin-1 in aged mice, abnormal {{21}} transport and BBB leakage were significantly reduced. The researchers then investigated why Mfsd2a declines during aging. They found that levels of TGF-β1, a {{22}} molecule involved in {{23}}, tissue repair and aging, increased in both the brain and the bloodstream as mice aged.
paragraphs.cn: Mfsd2a通常限制脑内血管的不必要运输。其水平随年龄增长而下降，而参与运输囊泡形成的蛋白质Caveolin-1则增加。当研究人员在老年小鼠中恢复内皮Mfsd2a表达或敲低Caveolin-1时，异常囊泡运输和血脑屏障渗漏显著减少。随后，研究人员调查了为什么Mfsd2a在衰老过程中下降。他们发现，随着小鼠年龄增长，大脑和血液中TGF-β1（一种参与炎症、组织修复和衰老的信号分子）的水平均增加。

paragraphs.en: Excessive TGF-β1 reduced Mfsd2a expression in the cells lining brain blood vessels, causing their transport activity to increase. Raising TGF-β1 levels in young mice caused them to develop several {{25}} normally seen in the aged BBB, including increased leakage. By contrast, {{26}} TGF-β signaling in aged mice reduced BBB leakage and improved their performance in memory-related {{27}} tests. The findings suggest that age-related BBB damage is not simply the result of {{28}} wear and tear. Instead, it involves biological signals that alter how brain blood vessel cells transport substances.
paragraphs.cn: 过量的TGF-β1降低了脑内血管内皮细胞中Mfsd2a的表达，导致其运输活性增加。在年轻小鼠中提高TGF-β1水平，使它们出现了通常见于衰老血脑屏障的多种特征，包括渗漏增加。相反，在老年小鼠中阻断TGF-β信号减少了血脑屏障渗漏，并改善了它们在记忆相关行为测试中的表现。这些发现表明，与年龄相关的血脑屏障损伤不仅仅是被动磨损的结果。相反，它涉及改变脑血管细胞运输物质的生物信号。

paragraphs.en: The study may help explain how vascular changes contribute to cognitive aging. It also points to potential approaches for protecting the aging brain, including maintaining Mfsd2a function or preventing {{24}} activation of TGF-β signaling. Further research will be needed to determine whether these {{29}} can be safely translated into treatments for humans.
paragraphs.cn: 这项研究可能有助于解释血管变化如何导致认知衰老。它还指出了保护衰老大脑的潜在方法，包括维持Mfsd2a功能或防止TGF-β信号的过度激活。需要进一步研究来确定这些策略是否能安全地转化为人类的治疗方法。

articles.fullText:
As people age, many experience memory decline and slower cognitive processing, along with a higher risk of cerebrovascular disease and cognitive impairment. One important question in aging research is how changes in the brain's blood vessels contribute to cognitive decline.
Scientists from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have identified a mechanism by which aging weakens the blood-brain barrier, the brain's protective interface with the bloodstream.
The study was published in Neuron under the title "TGF-β1-induced endothelial transcytosis drives blood-brain barrier leakage during aging."
The study shows how aging disrupts transport in brain blood vessel cells, leading to blood-brain barrier leakage. /SIAT
The blood-brain barrier, or BBB, acts as a selective security system. It allows essential nutrients to reach the brain while preventing potentially harmful substances in the blood from entering brain tissue. Damage to this barrier has been linked to cognitive aging, cerebral small vessel disease and several neurodegenerative disorders.
Scientists have traditionally attributed BBB leakage mainly to damage to the tight seals between cells lining brain blood vessels. However, the new study found that another process occurs earlier during aging.
By examining mice at different ages, the researchers found that BBB leakage was already detectable in middle-aged mice and worsened in older animals. The change appeared early in the hippocampus, a brain region important for learning and memory.
At this stage, the seals between blood vessel cells remained largely intact. Instead, the cells' internal transport system became abnormally active, allowing blood-borne substances to pass through the cells and enter brain tissue.
"Rather than first leaking through gaps between cells, the aging blood-brain barrier appears to lose control over transport pathways inside the cells," the researchers said.
The team identified a protein called Mfsd2a as an important part of this protective system. Mfsd2a normally limits unnecessary transport across brain blood vessels. Its levels declined with age, while Caveolin-1, a protein involved in the formation of transport vesicles, increased.
When the researchers restored endothelial Mfsd2a expression or knocked down Caveolin-1 in aged mice, abnormal vesicle transport and BBB leakage were significantly reduced.
The researchers then investigated why Mfsd2a declines during aging. They found that levels of TGF-β1, a signaling molecule involved in inflammation, tissue repair and aging, increased in both the brain and the bloodstream as mice aged.
Excessive TGF-β1 reduced Mfsd2a expression in the cells lining brain blood vessels, causing their transport activity to increase. Raising TGF-β1 levels in young mice caused them to develop several features normally seen in the aged BBB, including increased leakage.
By contrast, blocking TGF-β signaling in aged mice reduced BBB leakage and improved their performance in memory-related behavioral tests.
The findings suggest that age-related BBB damage is not simply the result of passive wear and tear. Instead, it involves biological signals that alter how brain blood vessel cells transport substances.
The study may help explain how vascular changes contribute to cognitive aging. It also points to potential approaches for protecting the aging brain, including maintaining Mfsd2a function or preventing excessive activation of TGF-β signaling. Further research will be needed to determine whether these strategies can be safely translated into treatments for humans.
articles.fullTextCn:
随着年龄增长，许多人会经历记忆力下降和认知处理速度变慢，同时患脑血管疾病和认知障碍的风险也会增加。衰老研究中的一个重要问题是大脑血管的变化如何导致认知衰退。中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院（SIAT）的科学家们识别出了一种衰老削弱血脑屏障（大脑与血液之间的保护性界面）的机制。该研究发表在《神经元》杂志上，题为“TGF-β1诱导的内皮细胞转胞吞作用驱动衰老过程中的血脑屏障渗漏”。该研究展示了衰老如何扰乱脑血管细胞中的运输，导致血脑屏障渗漏。血脑屏障（BBB）作为一个选择性的安全系统。

它允许必需营养物质到达大脑，同时防止血液中潜在的有害物质进入脑组织。这种屏障的损伤与认知衰老、脑小血管疾病和多种神经退行性疾病有关。科学家传统上将血脑屏障渗漏主要归因于脑内血管内皮细胞之间紧密连接的损伤。然而，新研究发现，在衰老过程中另一个过程发生得更早。通过检查不同年龄的小鼠，研究人员发现，血脑屏障渗漏在中年小鼠中已可检测到，并在老年动物中恶化。

这种变化早期出现在海马体，这是一个对学习和记忆重要的大脑区域。在这个阶段，血管细胞之间的连接基本保持完整。相反，细胞内部的运输系统变得异常活跃，使得血液中的物质穿过细胞进入脑组织。研究人员表示：“衰老的血脑屏障似乎不是首先通过细胞间隙渗漏，而是失去了对细胞内运输途径的控制。”团队识别出一种名为Mfsd2a的蛋白质，它是这个保护系统的重要组成部分。

Mfsd2a通常限制脑内血管的不必要运输。其水平随年龄增长而下降，而参与运输囊泡形成的蛋白质Caveolin-1则增加。当研究人员在老年小鼠中恢复内皮Mfsd2a表达或敲低Caveolin-1时，异常囊泡运输和血脑屏障渗漏显著减少。随后，研究人员调查了为什么Mfsd2a在衰老过程中下降。他们发现，随着小鼠年龄增长，大脑和血液中TGF-β1（一种参与炎症、组织修复和衰老的信号分子）的水平均增加。

过量的TGF-β1降低了脑内血管内皮细胞中Mfsd2a的表达，导致其运输活性增加。在年轻小鼠中提高TGF-β1水平，使它们出现了通常见于衰老血脑屏障的多种特征，包括渗漏增加。相反，在老年小鼠中阻断TGF-β信号减少了血脑屏障渗漏，并改善了它们在记忆相关行为测试中的表现。这些发现表明，与年龄相关的血脑屏障损伤不仅仅是被动磨损的结果。相反，它涉及改变脑血管细胞运输物质的生物信号。

这项研究可能有助于解释血管变化如何导致认知衰老。它还指出了保护衰老大脑的潜在方法，包括维持Mfsd2a功能或防止TGF-β信号的过度激活。需要进一步研究来确定这些策略是否能安全地转化为人类的治疗方法。

articles.fullText:
Israeli military vehicles drive past houses destroyed by Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon as seen from a position across the border in the Upper Galilee in northern Israel, July 22, 2026. 
Lebanon and Israel concluded their seventh round of US-brokered direct negotiations in Rome on Thursday, seeking to advance a phased withdrawal of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon and the deployment of the Lebanese army.
However, the three-day talks ended without a final breakthrough over the establishment of initial withdrawal zones, as cross-border violence and disputes over Hezbollah's disarmament continued to hamper progress.
The negotiations, held from Tuesday to Thursday at the US Embassy in Rome, marked the second round of talks hosted by the Italian capital after an earlier session in Washington, DC.
According to sources familiar with the discussions, the main disagreements centered on two pilot withdrawal zones. Israel insisted on verifying full Lebanese army control and tangible progress on Hezbollah's disarmament in the initial areas before expanding its military pullback, while Lebanon called for a faster and broader transition.
The two sides did make some limited progress. Sources said they exchanged preliminary lists of detainees and missing people. Lebanon submitted a list of Lebanese detainees and missing persons and insisted that the first step should be the release of an initial group of civilian detainees. Israel, meanwhile, provided a list containing the names of Lebanese Jews who went missing or were killed in Lebanon.
Negotiators also agreed on a short list of potential third parties for a future monitoring mechanism, according to the sources, though a final consensus on the composition of the verification committee has not yet been locked in.
The United States said a preliminary date for the next round of talks had been proposed for September 1.
Thursday's talks faced severe strain and temporary adjustments following a roadside blast in southern Lebanon on Wednesday that killed two Israeli soldiers, triggering retaliatory IDF air strikes and evacuation warnings.
On Thursday, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said it had carried out retaliatory strikes against Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon over the previous 24 hours in response to the deaths and injuries of Israeli troops a day earlier.
The IDF said that Israeli forces remained deployed in a designated "security zone" in southern Lebanon under existing arrangements and would continue operations there to eliminate threats against Israel and its military.
The latest escalation has marked the most intense exchange of fire between Israel and Hezbollah since late June, when a US-Israel-Lebanon framework agreement was reached, a UN spokesperson said Thursday.
The UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) recorded 113 projectiles fired by the IDF on Wednesday, the highest daily number since June 21, according to Farhan Haq, deputy spokesperson for UN Secretary-General António Guterres. UNIFIL said it detected no projectile launches by Hezbollah during the same period.
The escalation continued on Thursday. Between midnight and 4 p.m. local time, UNIFIL recorded 120 projectiles fired by the IDF, already surpassing Wednesday's full-day total and marking the highest daily figure since June 21, Haq said.
The renewed hostilities have raised concerns that military escalation could undermine diplomatic efforts aimed at consolidating the ceasefire, implementing the Lebanese army's expanded role in the south, and creating conditions for a long-term security arrangement along the Israel-Lebanon border.

The 25th China Internet Conference opens at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
Artificial intelligence is moving rapidly from experimental technology to real-world applications, as industry leaders showcased new AI-powered solutions for cities, businesses and consumers at the 25th China Internet Conference in Beijing.
Held from July 8 to 10, the conference highlighted how AI agents, large language models and digital twin technologies are being integrated into sectors ranging from urban governance and industrial manufacturing to retail and public services.
Speaking via video at the opening ceremony, Wu Hequan, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said AI-native technologies are reshaping the internet itself.
While large language models excel at general reasoning, AI agents are designed to execute specific tasks and future digital ecosystems will increasingly rely on collaboration among multiple intelligent agents rather than isolated AI systems.
Participants of the 25th China Internet Conference try on VR products at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
According to Wu, AI-generated traffic is expected to account for around 60% of global internet traffic by 2030, with AI agent services becoming the dominant source of token-based interactions. The shift, he said, will require internet infrastructure to evolve toward higher bandwidth, lower latency and stronger computing capabilities.
The conference also demonstrated how AI is being deployed in practical scenarios. Digital assistants are supporting office collaboration and customer services, while AI-powered inspection systems are improving industrial operations. Digital twin technologies are enabling more efficient traffic management, energy optimization and building maintenance, providing city managers with real-time visualization and decision-making tools.
Industry representatives also emphasized that AI innovation is creating measurable economic value.
Participants of the 25th China Internet Conference interact with humanoid robots at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
At the conference, Kuaishou said its AI-powered video generation model and digital human live-streaming platform have helped small and medium-sized businesses increase daily gross merchandise value while significantly reducing marketing costs. Alibaba's Taobao Instant Commerce platform reported that AI agents are increasingly handling complex shopping requests, moving beyond traditional keyword-based searches to task-oriented consumer services.
Beyond applications, participants identified trustworthy AI and green computing as key priorities for the industry's next stage of development. The launch of the FlagOS Initiative, an open AI software platform designed to improve compatibility across different computing chips, reflects broader efforts to build more efficient and sustainable AI infrastructure.
As AI technologies continue to mature, industry experts believe the focus is shifting from developing models to deploying them at scale. The conference highlighted China's efforts to accelerate AI adoption across the real economy, with intelligent applications increasingly becoming part of everyday life while supporting digital transformation and high-quality economic development.

articles.fullText:
Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan, chairman of Indonesia's National Economic Council, stated recently that Indonesia will take steps to strengthen investor confidence, noting that China's support and assistance are indispensable, and there are broad prospects for investment cooperation between the two countries.
He made the remarks when attending the G20 Bali Global Blended Finance Forum in May.
Luhut noted that with rapid development, Indonesia's national development has entered a new phase, making it vital for the country to expand foreign investment and introduce advanced technologies.o has explicitly demanded fostering a favorable business environment for foreign investment and instructed that necessary measures be taken to boost investor confidence.
Luhut said that investment cooperation with China and Indonesia has deepened in recent years. Experience shows that China not only possesses advanced technology but is also willing to share its development experience with Indonesia genuinely, rather than merely offering verbal promises.
In the future, Indonesia will increase investment in areas such as digital infrastructure, artificial intelligence, healthcare and the construction of international financial centers. China's support and assistance will be indispensable, and the two sides have vast potential for investment cooperation, Luhut added.
articles.fullTextCn:
印尼国家经济委员会主席卢胡特·宾萨·潘查伊坦最近表示，印尼将采取措施增强投资者信心，并指出中国的支持和援助不可或缺，两国之间的投资合作前景广阔。他是在5月出席G20巴厘岛全球混合金融论坛时发表上述言论的。卢胡特指出，随着快速发展，印尼的国家发展已进入新阶段，因此扩大外国投资和引进先进技术对国家至关重要。

卢胡特表示，近年来中国与印尼的投资合作不断深化。经验表明，中国不仅拥有先进技术，还愿意真诚地与印尼分享其发展经验，而不仅仅是口头承诺。未来，印尼将加大对数字基础设施、人工智能、医疗保健和国际金融中心建设等领域的投资。中国的支持和援助将不可或缺，双方在投资合作方面潜力巨大，卢胡特补充道。
